title: Thought
description: One captured thought. Produced by any input layer, enriched by the capture model, owned by the service. The markdown ledger line and the phone reminder are projections of this object.

id.description: ULID minted at capture by the input layer, or by the service when the layer cannot.

session.description: Claude session id or repo path when captured mid-session

raw.description: Verbatim utterance, spoken or typed. Never shown back. Kept by the service until the record has a type, then dropped; the ledger line remains the raw copy.

text.description: Shortest complete restatement, imperative mood. Names and places verbatim.

notes.description: The one field the capture model may write freely, bounded. For idea: two or three possible directions. For lookup: the one-line result. For an acted item: the briefing the service keeps. Otherwise null.

category.description: User-facing grouping. idea is project-directed; question is for Claude at the next session.

lifecycle.description: Memory-schema type. Best effort at capture, final at consolidation.

window.description: ISO 8601 duration for a bounded directive, e.g. P1M

as_said.description: the phrase that produced the date, e.g. 'Thursday at 2'

name.description: A place the user has named once (a-friends-house, grocery). Never coordinates.

people.description: names as said; informational only, nothing is ever sent to them

surface.description: When the service should bring this back up. Evaluated deterministically; no model in the query.

mode.description: on_cue: at when/where. on_project_session: when a session starts in project.slug. daily_digest: in the once-a-day open-loop set. on_demand: only when asked. never: fact or note kept for recall only.

remind.description: true means push outward, not just include in context

expires_at.description: end of the grace window; after this the miss policy applies

misses.description: times surfaced without a response; drives demotion

action.description: The deterministic thing the router did, if any. The model names the kind; the host chooses and runs the tool and reports the rest.

kind.description: fixed set named by the router; the host maps it to a tool. calendar covers create and edit; lookup is one web search. Anything needing more inference sets routing.escalate instead.

tool.description: the host's tool that applied the kind, e.g. ios.reminders, google.calendar, or an MCP tool name; set by the host, never by the model

external_id.description: id in the target system, for completion sync

applied_by.description: who executed it; a phone client applies phone-local actions the service could not

routing.description: How the record was classified. Every capture has this; it is the label a lifecycle classifier trains on.

stage.description: rules: deterministic match resolved it. model: the capture model routed or enriched it. log: nothing acted, stored for later.

model.description: id of the model that filled the schema when stage is model. Includes the session model when the Claude Code skill is the capture host; a classifier's training set is stratified by this field.

escalate.description: the model judged this needs a higher-class model or a tool outside the fixed set; logged and surfaced at the next session as runnable

input_truncated.description: raw exceeded the capture-model input cap and was cut

state.description: Derived by folding events. Never set directly.

supersedes.description: id of the record this one replaced

events.description: Append-only. Any surface may append; the service is the only writer of the array.
